beats.vo_text: Ye kahani kisi social media afwaah par nahi, balki Kota Residency archives aur Maharao Brijraj Singh ki personal diary par darj hai. Brijraj Bhawan aaj ek heritage hotel hai jahan mehman aaram se dinner karte hain, lekin theek 12:30 baje second floor ka corridor ajeeb thandak se bhar jata hai. Lekin 1857 mein Major Charles Burton of 40th Bengal Native Infantry ke sath ek aisi ghatna ghati jisne is poore ilaaqe ki taqdeer badal di.

beats.vo_text: Sabse khaufnaak hadsa tab report hua jab hotel ke sote hue night guards aur un-disciplined staff ke gaal par achanak kisi adrishya hath se zor ka thappad padta hai aur British accent mein aawaz aati hai! Chashmadeedo ke mutabiq unhone deewar par dekha ki sadiyon purana ek saya bina zameen ko chhue tezi se unki taraf badh raha tha! Unhone cheekh kar kaha: 'Attention! Don't sleep on duty!' — aur unke paas wahan se bhaagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!
